title: Crunchy Granola Suite NEIL DIAMOND
lyrics_plain:
Da da da da
Da da da da dum
Deet deet deet dum
I got a song been on my mind,
And the tune can be sung
And the words all rhyme.
Deedle ee deet
Deet deet deet deet deet
Deedle dee doo.
Though it don't say much
And it won't offend
If you sing it at school
They're liable to send you home
Never knowin' what you're showin'
Think you're growin' your own tea.
DIG!
Let me hear that,
Get me near that
Crunchy Granola Suite.
Drop your shrink and stop your drinkin'
Crunchy Granola's neat!
Sing it out,
All right.
Da da da da
Da da da da dum
Deet deet deet dum
I know a man was out of touch
And he'd hide in a house
And he didn't say much.
Deedle ee deet
Deet deet deet deet deet
Deedle dee doo.
And like a man with a tiger
Outside his gate,
He not only couldn't relax,
But he couldn't relate
Now he can.
Family man tried my brand.
DIG!
Let me hear that,
Get me near that
Crunchy Granola Suite.
Drop your shrink and stop your drinkin'
Crunchy Granola's neat!
Sing it out,
All right.
Da da da da
Da da da da dum
Deet deet deet dum
